title: Ecological Niche Modeling for AI Model Output Spaces

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: niche analysis reveals which models in a portfolio are genuinely complementary vs. redundant. Directly actionable for portfolio design and diversity assessment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Ecological diversity indices (Shannon, Rao, Pianka) are mathematical but well-documented. Implementing them on AI output embeddings requires intermediate programming and some statistical sophistication.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: define output niche operationally, compute niche overlap for 20+ models on a probe set, visualize results. Well-defined analysis pipeline achievable in 30 hours.

novelty.reasoning: Ecological niche modeling is a mature field (Current Biology 2024 review, MDPI 2024 advances survey), and LLM output diversity measurement using entropy and embedding-based methods is actively studied (G2 for guided diverse generation, EMNLP 2025; Shannon entropy-based diversity metrics). However, the specific cross-domain application — using ecological niche overlap indices (Shannon, Rao's quadratic entropy, Pianka's overlap index) to operationally define and measure the 'output niche' of AI models and compute inter-model niche overlap — has not been published. Existing diversity metrics for LLMs (distinct-n, embedding cosine distance, semantic entropy) do not use the ecological niche framework. This is a genuinely novel cross-domain methodological contribution.

evidence: Guided Generation for Enhanced Output Diversity in LLMs. EMNLP 2025.
Entropy Dynamics in LLMs: Metrics and Implications. EmergentMind 2025.
